Safety and Tolerability of Fb-PMT in Recurrent Glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: fb-PMT affects a large group of cancer cell signaling pathways and thus may be effective in heterogeneous, treatment-resistant tumors such as Glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven intracranial glioblastoma, with first or second recurrence

role_evidence.quote: Daily subcutaneous injection of fb-PMT in four escalating cohorts to determine maximum tolerated dose, followed by treatment of up to 10 additional patients at maximum tolerated dose.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational agent (other names NP-100, NP751) acting on cancer cell signalling pathways; full name not given
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: affects a large group of cancer cell signaling pathways

coder_notes: Single-arm phase 1 dose escalation; no molecular selection and no PK/PD measurement planned.
